tr8-compact-actuator/GUIDE.md.before: The supplied nut drawing specifies a 22×11 mm flange, R11 ends, two Ø3.5 mounting holes on 16 mm centres, Ø10 body and 15 mm overall axial length. The axial stack is a 1.5 mm nose, 3.5 mm flange and 10 mm rear body. The 22 mm flange direction lies along Y, keeping its 11 mm height clear of the nearby output shaft. Two M3×8 button screws pass through the stock flange into the machined cover's blind M3 taps; no separate nuts are used there.
tr8-compact-actuator/GUIDE.md.after: The supplied H-flange nut drawing, which has no verified public URL, specifies a 22×11 mm flange, R11 ends, two Ø3.5 mounting holes on 16 mm centres, Ø10 body and 15 mm overall axial length. The axial stack is a 1.5 mm nose, 3.5 mm flange and 10 mm rear body. The 22 mm flange direction lies along Y, keeping its 11 mm height clear of the nearby output shaft. Two M3×8 button screws pass through the stock flange into the machined cover's blind M3 taps; no separate nuts are used there.
